trap.label: the… the
trap.wrong: More I give, more I learn.
trap.right: The more I give, the more I learn.
trap.why: O português diz “quanto mais… mais” sem artigo. Em inglês, the é obrigatório antes de cada comparativo.

mcq.q: ___ sooner you book, the cheaper it is.
The louder the music, the ___ the neighbors complain.
The ___ she practiced, the better she played.

fix.wrong: The more you read, better you write.
fix.right: The more you read, the better you write.

fix.wrong: More I give, more I learn.
fix.right: The more I give, the more I learn.

fix.wrong: The harder she practiced, the more good she played.
fix.right: The harder she practiced, the better she played.

rewrite.prompt: Una: “You read more. You write better.” (The more…)
rewrite.answer: The more you read, the better you write.

rewrite.prompt: Una: “It is cheap if you book early.” (The earlier…)
rewrite.answer: The earlier you book, the cheaper it is.

rewrite.prompt: Una: “We give more. We learn more.”
rewrite.answer: The more we give, the more we learn.
